stations.title: Rosamund
stations.say: Is every owner on my card list?

stations.title: owners
stations.text: A join keeps only owners with an animal.
stations.note: Nia's kitten is not in yet.

captions: Rosamund writes the Christmas cards from a list of owners and their animals.
Nia has signed up but her kitten has not come in, so a plain join leaves her out.
You keep every row of one table, and find the rows with no partner, in three tasks.
Now Nia is on the list, with an empty space where her kitten will go.
Same tables, and now no row goes missing without a word.
